To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the new fuzzy clustering algorithm, called fuzzy-minimals is able to detect the possible prototypes of groups of a sample.
a new algorithm for possibilistic clustering is presented, and the new algorithm detects the possible prototypes for the groups of a fuzzy sample.
a local geometrical properties of a cluster is used to define the membership function of the fuzzy clustering and the objective function is based on the covariance matrix of the sample.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a new fuzzy clustering algorithm that is able to detect the possible prototypes of a sample.
the application of the geometrical properties of a fuzzy clustering algorithm.
the study of the metric derived from covariance matrix, and its use in the fuzzy clustering.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fuzzy-minimals algorithm provides a better performance than the fuzzy C-meens algorithm in the detection of the prototypes of a sample.
fuzzy clustering is a powerful tool for the analysis of data and the fuzzy-minimals is an effective algorithm.
the new algorithm provides an efficient tool to detect the groups of a data set, and the number of groups is not a parameter to be fixed by the user.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed an algorithm to find a set of fuzzy clusters in a data set, which are as compact as possible and as well separated as possible.
we present a new algorithm that is based on the Mahalanobics metric and the fuzzy-minimals algorithm.
a new geometrical properties application is introduced for fuzzy clustering, where we obtain an objective function and a membership function.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the geometrical properties of the covariance matrix can be used to obtain the prototypes in fuzzy clustering.
the geometrical properties of the fuzzy clustering algorithms can be used to obtain more robust results in the presence of outliers.
the new algorithm can be used to detect outliers in data, and that it can be used as a preprocessing tool to improve the performance of the fuzzy clustering algorithm.
